title: From Prediction to Action: Population Health World Model for Digital Medicine
abstract: arXiv:2610.24662v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Digital medicine now captures data that traces individual health trajectories and reveals population health dynamics through electronic health records, claims, remote monitoring, wearable devices, mobile devices, social sensing data, medical images, etc. But much of its modeling still centers on task-specific, outcome-specific, and prediction-specific estimation. The next frontier is not simply better prediction, but action in an evolving health world shaped by multiple decision-makers, heterogeneous populations, resource constraints, and feedback in care delivery. This is why digital medicine now needs world models: not only to estimate what will happen, but to represent how actions change what can happen next -- whom to prioritize, how to allocate scarce resources, how to adapt care across subgroups, and how interventions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics.   We call such a model population health world mode

translated_title: 从预测到行动：面向数字医学的人群健康世界模型
translated_abstract: 数字医学如今通过电子健康记录、理赔数据、远程监测、可穿戴设备、移动设备、社交感知数据、医学影像等，捕获能够追踪个体健康轨迹并揭示人群健康动态的数据。但其大部分建模仍然以任务特定、结局特定和预测特定的估计为中心。下一个前沿不是简单地做出更好的预测，而是在一个由多个决策者、异质性人群、资源约束和医疗反馈共同塑造的动态健康世界中采取行动。这就是数字医学现在需要世界模型的原因：不仅要估计将会发生什么，还要表征行动如何改变接下来可能发生的事情——优先照顾谁、如何分配稀缺资源、如何在不同亚群间调整医疗照护，以及干预措施如何重塑未来的健康轨迹和人群动态。我们将这样的模型称为人群健康世界模型。
tldr: 该论文提出数字医学应从单纯的任务特定预测转向构建“人群健康世界模型”，用以表征行动如何改变未来健康轨迹与人群动态，从而支持优先级判断、稀缺资源分配和跨亚群的医疗干预决策。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that digital medicine needs to move beyond task-specific prediction toward a "population health world model" that represents how actions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics, enabling decisions on prioritization, scarce resource allocation, and adaptive care across subgroups.
